episodes.title: Episode 13: Tales, Tales, Tales
episodes.description_html:
This week, HBI has dispatched its correspondents to the front lines of the modern automotive market.

Justin “The Juice” reports from Knoxville, where a family car-shopping expedition becomes a confrontation between enthusiast logic and the realities of aging parents, comfortable seats and Toyota hybrid noises. The Crown Signia makes a strong case, Lexus and Alfa receive careful consideration, and the Mazda CX-90 emerges as the leading contender. One important question remains for our enthusiastic youth correspondent: turbo straight-six or plug-in hybrid?

From HBI's Twin Cities bureau, Geno introduces the newest member of the Fleet of Hammpions: a Tropic Green 1995 Volvo 940 Turbo with 220,000 miles, excellent modifications and a set of gold wheels waiting in the garage.

Caleb returns with a dispatch from The Land That Stellantis Forgot, detailing Fiat electrical progress, tales of large pandas and the competitive advantage of only one windshield wiper.

Sit back, put your feet up and let the good times roll.

episodes.title: Episode 11: Bad Decisions and Great Music
episodes.description_html:
This morning's episode of The International Race of Hammpions is sponsored by Antonio's Italian Car Specialists in Lutts, TN. Tell 'em The HAMM sent you.

In this episode, we reveal the new shop runner in the Brazilian studio, workshop the worst possible automotive engine swap, and discuss the greatest driving albums, in our not-so-humble opinions. As always, we have check-ins from The Reservoir Report and The Glizzy Gladiator of the Great Lakes. All of this and more, coming to you live from where you get your podcasts.

The International Race of Hammpions is a production of Hammpions Broadcast International.

Caleb's Picks

  • Out Loud - Boom Boom Satellites
  • Gran Turismo - The Cardigans
  • Slow Riot for New Zerø Kanada - Godspeed You! Black Emperor
  • Aqualung - Jethro Tull
  • Thick as a Brick - Jethro Tull
  • Candyass - Orgy
  • Vapor Transmission - Orgy
  • Bigger, Better, Faster, More! - 4 Non Blondes
  • Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex O.S.T. - Yoko Kanno
  • Exit - Tangerine Dream

Justin's Picks

  • Songs for the Deaf - Queens of the Stone Age
  • Honestly, Nevermind - Drake
  • Skream! - Skream
  • The Resistance - Muse
  • The Wow! Signal - Muse
  • Funeral Soundtrack #4 - Destroy Boys
  • Reload - Metallica

  • British Steel - Judas Priest

Geno's Picks

  • The Legend of Blacktop Jesus - Andy Lipke / North Shore Trio
  • The Animal Years - Josh Ritter
  • Led Zeppelin IV - Led Zeppelin
  • Lohio - Ass Ponys
  • Electric Rock Music - Ass Ponys
  • Enema of the State - Blink-182
  • Californication - Red Hot Chili Peppers
  • Sailing the Seas of Cheese - Primus
  • Die Welt gehört dir - Blümchen
  • Autobahn - Kraftwerk

Collective Picks

  • (Pronounced 'Lĕh-'nérd 'Skin-'nérd) - Lynyrd Skynyrd
  • Second Helping - Lynyrd Skynyrd
  • Nuthin’ Fancy - Lynyrd Skynyrd
  • Gimme Back My Bullets - Lynyrd Skynyrd

General Picks

From Caleb - Public Enemy, Mogwai and Godspeed You! Black Emperor in general.

From Justin - Initial D-style Eurobeat, Pendulum, early Three 6 Mafia

From Geno - Tony Hawk's Pro Skater soundtrack and the GTA Vice City radio music
